card.name: Words just before 'interaction' in drug-interaction text
card.fires_on: The word right before 'interactions' or 'interaction' in drug-interaction sections, such as 'Clinically Significant' in 'Drugs without Clinically Significant Interactions'. Also fires inside drug names or terms that lead into interaction wording.

modes.label: Heading before Interactions
modes.description: The word 'Significant' in section headings of the form 'Drugs without Clinically Significant Interactions with [drug]'.
modes.example: 7.4 Drugs without Clinically<< Significant>> Interactions with DESCOVY Based

modes.label: Modifier before interaction
modes.description: A descriptive word that comes just before 'drug interactions' or 'interaction' in running text.
modes.example: There are no clinical data available to confirm transporter<< based>> interaction.

modes.label: Inside names in interaction sections
modes.description: Partway through a drug or enzyme name in a drug-interaction section.
modes.example: No information is available on the quantitative effects of CYP<<3>>A

card.writes: It promotes the word 'inter' and its variants, which predicts that 'interaction' comes next.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'interactions' in drug-interaction sections.
